verdict.rationale: LM Studio's first-party `lms` CLI documents `lms get` for searching and downloading models. It also documents `lms load` with GPU, context-length and identifier options, plus `lms server start/stop`, which covers the core search/download/load workflow from the terminal. Management beyond loading is thin in the evidence. missing for 10: documented CLI commands for listing, unloading, or deleting local models; independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI model-management workflow.
